purpose: Agent-readable Databricks data-resource catalog for Codex, Claude Code, and similar coding agents.

collection_method.source: Unity Catalog REST metadata via Databricks SDK, transformed from README_data_resources.md

schema_summary.primary_role: production-style TOO ingest, curation, and aggregates
legacy/development YouTube collection, update, transcript, and channel-stat tables

query_safety: Start with Unity Catalog metadata and LIMIT queries before scanning large tables.
Avoid count(*), distinct, broad select *, and unbounded date scans unless the user explicitly asks and compute cost is acceptable.
Prefer prod_tads.youtube_too.yt_sl_* for analysis surfaces; use yt_bz_ingest only for raw-field provenance/debugging.
Use dev_sean.default as provenance/development context, not the cleanest analysis layer.
For yt_lid_v3_* tables, respect run_id and channel_hash_bucket partitions when filtering.
notes_for_code_agents: This JSON is the machine-readable companion to src/README_data_resources.md.
Fields were generated from metadata-only calls; row counts and value ranges are intentionally absent.
Descriptions are concise agent hints and should be verified against code/docs before publication-critical claims.
Columns are complete as returned by Unity Catalog metadata at generation time.

relationships.join_or_flow: Pipeline-derived; use silver tables for analysis unless raw ingest fields are explicitly needed.
Likely join on channel_id plus capture/ingest context when doing point-in-time metric analysis.
Likely join on video_id/channel_id plus capture/ingest context when doing point-in-time metric analysis.
Join channel-level language outputs to channel metadata on channel_id.
Language pipeline creates per-field text segments from channel/video metadata; segment outputs retain channel_id/video_id/segment_id.
Join by run_id, channel_hash_bucket, segment_id, and channel/video identifiers as needed.
Current channel-level dual-model language outputs and QA tables are run-scoped by run_id.
